Starting from APP–TRIT–TPK and the joint construction of the numerical and exceptional projections, it develops the constants, the structure of the electron, the mass operators, and the realizations of action, gravity, and information. Definitions, theorems, examples, and verification procedures allow the dependencies between results to be reconstructed. It is the technical reference for studying how a common genealogy transmits structure between results, within the domain specified for each claim.

documents.body: This monograph proves compatibility and restitution relations between action, propagation, mass, and information. Speed and impedance recover the spectrum of the constitutive channels; the Barbero–Immirzi functional distinguishes their oriented distribution, and the Catalan moment preserves the functional response. Composing elliptic transformations restores the action coefficient and records the order of operations. The marked length and its memory complement connect action and gravitation through a conserved area. In the thermal realization, the cycle supplies energy and the spectral reference supplies the informational weight; both are transported with the area and horizon section. A mass coordinate relates frequency and reciprocal lengths. These identities explain how constants are reconstructed from one another while preserving orientation, units, and the domain of each operation. The total action joins geometry, the strong and electroweak sectors and chiral matter, with compatible backreaction and constraints in the regular realisation. Horizon relations link area, entropy and temperature and preserve their joint transformation with action.

rows.name: Exceptional–Temporal Determination
rows.explanation: The selector traverses 19,446 candidates in the terminal domain; 79 satisfy exceptional compatibility, and one also satisfies the temporal condition. Hadamard inversion recovers the selected record in another representation: recovery and selection perform distinct functions within the same construction.

rows.name: Conservation and Reversibility of Information
rows.explanation: The bilateral law and the infinite archive preserve the norm and allow the state to be reconstructed. Phase return does not erase memory: restitution depends on preserving the relations of the complete sequence.

rows.name: Marked Incidence, Leech, Moonshine, and M-Theory
rows.explanation: The Witt flag organizes the gluing, and the marked vector of squared norm 54 determines the rootless Leech neighbour. The vertex operator construction leads to the Moonshine module, with the Monster as its automorphism group. The constant’s record also determines a nonzero direction: its complement fixes the reduction 11 → 10 after the uniform mode is removed in 12 → 11. This polarization is coordinated with the 26 → 24 screen and T-duality. The prolongation towards M-theory transports the action and the identity Q² = H through the stated isometries and domains; the physical identification preserves the specific conditions of that realization.

rows.name: Real Line and Internal Cardinal Classification
rows.explanation: Compatible cylinders construct the line without introducing it as an initial datum. Genealogical closure prolongs the record through subsets definable with parameters already produced. Condensation assigns ordinal codes to the internal reals; the coding of countable well-orders and their ternary lifting construct the inverse injection. Cantor–Bernstein establishes cardinal equality. The classification covers the internal subsets of this line: infinite subsets are countable or equinumerous with the constructed continuum. The domain preserves the memory of its construction and the two projections from which it arises.

tables.intro: The kernel extends through distinct readers of the same structure. Residues and torsion determine characters; their moments produce spectral constants. Regularization preserves the finite parts of those moments. Compatible cylinders then allow resolutions and information rates to be compared. The recognized formulas come at the end of these constructions. Sources: the integral corpus, chapters 41–45, and the systematic treatise.

tables.intro: The coefficient is obtained as a relative intensity of the marked spectral reference. The thermal reading combines information per reference and conditioned energy; their derivative fixes temperature in the transported bases.

The number exactly matches the SI numeral of Boltzmann’s constant; the physical identification retains these operations and the energy and temperature bases. synthesis: Triadic Modular Holography and Dimensional Mechanics develop a unified explanation of the origin of constants and the relations underlying physics. The discrete construction of the continuum brings number, geometry, symmetry and physical magnitude into a common genealogy. It addresses a historical question in the relationship between mathematics and physics: what determines fundamental values, and what organisation they express. Explaining a constant encompasses its generation, the relations fixing its value and its role in transformations. Structure determines mathematical consequences; metrology tests their realisations in physical units.

The APP–TRIT–TPK kernel articulates this construction. APP brings addition and multiplication together on a common support; TRIT introduces orientation and a ternary regime; the Topological Phase Kernel transports configurations with memory, carry, boundary and path. In the nonadic connection, phase returns while memory advances. Each compatible extension increases resolution and preserves the dependencies of preceding levels. The generation of a number determines its value and retains the relations it transmits to subsequent constructions.

The central thesis is the double projection of a single discrete structure of the continuum. Refinement of oriented half-open cylinders reduces their diameters and determines real coordinates; compatibility between local domains reconstructs the Archimedean line. The conjugate projection preserves boundary incidences and their exceptional stabilisers. Measurement and symmetry express two related aspects of the same constitution: every value retains a geometric origin, an orientation and a memory. This unity connects arithmetic, geometry and physical organisation.

From this genealogy, π, φ and e are generated to arbitrary depth and α is derived through two internal routes. The electron connects algebraic structure, action and observable mass. Outward and return sections determine the Planck scale; the memory complement and α construct a length whose area, composed with action and propagation, determines G = c³L²/ℏ. Length precedes the gravitational coefficient. Planck, Boltzmann, permeability and permittivity are connected with Barbero–Immirzi and entanglement entropy through explicit operations and common dimensional realisations.

The holographic constant concentrates this continuity. Exceptional and temporal compatibility determines a unique record in the terminal domain. The same record enters the arithmetic closure of α, reversible information conservation and the incidences leading to Steiner, Golay and Leech. The chain extends to vertex operator algebras, Moonshine and the Monster. Modular reciprocity and dimensional decompositions articulate the connections with T-duality and M-theory, preserving the common origin of the representations.

The general mass law converts the persistence of configurations into positive operators, state classification and spectra. It brings particles, paths, orbits and mass readers into a common construction. The hexad–octad transition relates equal area to different sector composition and entropy, connecting information and quantum mixing. Bose–Einstein, Fermi–Dirac and the radiation laws extend the construction to collective behaviour. Gravitation, primes, the zeta function, Grassmannians and cardinality develop the argument further. Magnitudes express structure; understanding an entity means explaining its constitution, persistence and possibilities of transformation.
document_presentation: This collection brings together the knowledge developed in Triadic Modular Holography and Dimensional Mechanics for study and academic transfer. Its texts, programs, data, tables and digital certificates make it possible to examine the operations, reproduce the calculations and follow dependencies from the foundations to their mathematical and physical consequences.

The integral corpus and the systematic treatise are the principal references. The former assembles foundations and developments produced with the assistance of artificial intelligence systems under the authors’ direction; the latter sets out the operations and proof steps in greater detail. Two shorter, complementary routes facilitate access to this foundational material. The time-crystal monograph studies the double projection of the continuum and the relationship between periodicity and memory. The narrative exposition places the historical and conceptual problem in context and explains the significance of its mathematical and physical consequences.

The twelve monographs extract constructions, proofs, and applications from the foundational documents, following their dependencies. I generates π, φ, and e, derives α, and develops the algebraic structure of the electron. II constructs the Planck sections, angle and counter-angle, Barbero–Immirzi, entanglement, and CKM mixing; it articulates the thermal realization of Boltzmann and the connection between Planck length and gravitation. III derives Catalan’s constant, permittivity, and permeability; it reconstructs the constitutive function and obtains impedance, propagation speed, and quantum electrical relations.

IV develops the arithmetic origin of exceptional symmetries from the difference between sum and product. It follows the incidences of the formal kernel through Witt, Golay, Leech, Moonshine and the Monster, and articulates their extensions towards T-duality and M-theory. V obtains the Bose–Einstein and Fermi–Dirac distributions and radiation laws. VI defines a particle through persistence, classifies states and paths, and constructs the general mass law and its operator; the annex brings together states, paths, masses and widths.

VII proves compatibility and restitution between action, length, gravitation, propagation, mass and information while preserving the order of transformations. VIII develops the gravitational and torsional response, field equations and the transition from contraction to expansion. IX connects primes, the zeta function and Weil positivity. X constructs positive Grassmannian and amplituhedral representations, lattice duality and the Yang–Mills mass gap, with their length and area readings. XI constructs the real line discretely and classifies its internal subsets within holographic closure. XII determines the holographic constant and the laws of information conservation, recovery and reversibility.

The collection makes an extensive investigation accessible in the service of mathematical and physical knowledge. It is offered for study, reproduction, assessment and academic use, and as a basis for possible scientific publications. The exposition connects operations, objects and relations with their physical realisations and metrological comparison; the proofs and executable materials allow the content, its provenance and its scope to be studied together.
